_instructions: Values for the comparison with published systems (BUILD_PLAN 4a, Stages 2-3).
Every value is copied exactly from the PDF in '30 RESEARCH PAPERS/' (git-ignored), with its page and table/figure.
page = the page number printed on the paper (for Jannelli, printed page = PDF page - 1).
If a value is not in the paper: value null, not_in_paper true, and say so in note. Never fill from memory.
Peer-reviewed versions only. Filled 28 Nov 2026 from text extracted with pypdf; check against the PDF before publication.
